```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


Load packages and libraries.

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(rmarkdown)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl) 
library(openxlsx)


require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/2025_study_retention_analysis/Analysis/")

```


Import data. 
Format categorical variables to be read by the table calculations.

```{r}
metadata <- read_excel("/metadata/r_all_metadata_output.xlsx")


## Keep participants with a recorded reason for attrition.
attrition_data <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(reason_for_attrition),
         reason_for_attrition != "")


## Total number of participants with a reason for attrition.
N_attrition <- nrow(attrition_data) # Sums to total number of participants lost to contact


## Main attrition reason counts
main_reasons <- attrition_data %>%
  count(reason_for_attrition, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / N_attrition
  )


## Subgroup attrition reason counts
subgroups <- attrition_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(reason_for_attrition_subgroup),
    reason_for_attrition_subgroup != ""
  ) %>%
  count(
    reason_for_attrition,
    reason_for_attrition_subgroup,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / N_attrition
  )
```



Assemble the table.
```{r}
## Define the display order and labels
attrition_table <- bind_rows(

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Lost to contact") %>%
    transmute(
      order = 1,
      Reason = "Lost to contact",
      n, pct
    ),

  subgroups %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Lost to contact") %>%
    transmute(
      order = case_when(
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup ==
          "No response/contact details changed" ~ 1.1,
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup ==
          "Change in caregiver/guardianship" ~ 1.2,
        TRUE ~ 1.9
      ),
      Reason = paste0("   ", reason_for_attrition_subgroup),
      n, pct
    ),

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Personal or family circumstances") %>%
    transmute(
      order = 2,
      Reason = "Personal or family circumstances",
      n, pct
    ),

  subgroups %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Personal or family circumstances") %>%
    transmute(
      order = case_when(
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup ==
          "Competing personal commitments" ~ 2.1,
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup ==
          "Participant health circumstances" ~ 2.2,
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup ==
          "Family health or caregiving responsibilities" ~ 2.3,
        TRUE ~ 2.9
      ),
      Reason = paste0("   ", reason_for_attrition_subgroup),
      n, pct
    ),

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "No longer interested") %>%
    transmute(order = 3, Reason = reason_for_attrition, n, pct),

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Deceased") %>%
    transmute(order = 4, Reason = reason_for_attrition, n, pct),

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Other barriers") %>%
    transmute(order = 5, Reason = reason_for_attrition, n, pct),

  subgroups %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Other barriers") %>%
    transmute(
      order = case_when(
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup == "Incarceration" ~ 5.1,
        reason_for_attrition_subgroup == "Transportation barriers" ~ 5.2,
        TRUE ~ 5.9
      ),
      Reason = paste0("   ", reason_for_attrition_subgroup),
      n, pct
    ),

  main_reasons %>%
    filter(reason_for_attrition == "Moved out of study area") %>%
    transmute(order = 6, Reason = reason_for_attrition, n, pct)

) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  mutate(`n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f)", n, pct)) %>%
  select(Reason, `n (%)`)


## Print Table 2
attrition_table
```



```{r}
unique(metadata$reason_for_attrition)
unique(metadata$reason_for_attrition_subgroup)
```



Save table 2.
```{r}
write.xlsx(
  attrition_table,
  file = "/output/Table2_output.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```
